content.summary: The integrated manuscript has a coherent provenance chain: inherited A1K structure and reduction, new conditional Profile A and unconditional Profile B exclusions, and an ordinary numerical corollary using the explicitly external I27 theorem. The abstract and discussion preserve this chain and bound novelty to compared sources. No source claim or historical comparison requires revision.

checks.method: Reread the frozen abstract, inherited-input list, theorem list, Section 6 and discussion as a connected claim chain; compared attribution with verified primary statements and previously inspected MinimumTransversals source.
checks.observation: The inherited items supply the degree cap, two-high cap and I27-dependent 81 boundary; the synchronized transversal statement is separately credited to this development. Theorem 2 expressly retains I27, Theorem 1 gives the unrestricted-support two-star bound, and Theorem 3 composes the exclusions under I27. Corollary 4 adds external Proposition 6.7. The phrase discharging A and B is thus used in the conditional endpoint context rather than backed by an unconditional Profile A theorem. No contradictory theorem-strength assertion appears.

checks.scope: Historical contribution narrative versus evidence strength
checks.method: Checked every numerical literature claim in the abstract against Section 7 and the references, using the precise theorem mapping verified in rounds 1–3 and the lower-witness check from round 5.
checks.observation: The 83 and 81 baselines refer to different source results but use the same stated maximum-size convention. The 54 construction is described as known rather than new. The article is called a preprint, its code is not treated as independent confirmation, and conditional all-rank tracking material is not used for the fixed-rank endpoint. The contribution paragraph credits actual-family exclusions without promoting the failed SAT or stronger45 diagnostics. Search silence remains explicitly bounded.
